decisions.reason: The industrial AC voltage input module supports the firm's push into industrial automation and energy management and has a dedicated page, so it stays in the modular system.
A four-channel solid state relay is a low-maintenance standard control building block that complements the platform's automation offering.
The RGB LED control module is a recent, inexpensive addition built on the established platform and deserves time to gain traction with developers and educational users.
Remote access for wallboxes directly supports the strategic expansion of charging and energy management products and adds service value to the installed base.
